why_no_new_id: This amends the requested inference calibration of the existing claimed task only. It creates no scientific record, decision, correction, experiment, run, evidence, or status transition.

authorization.rationale: The public resolver accepts `reasoning_effort='high'` as the per-task calibration knob on the existing verified OpenAI/gpt-5.6-terra executor route, with no cap, fallback, or degraded requirements. The medium executor implementation attempts exposed concrete implementation-quality defects; high effort is authorized solely to repair and rigorously test the same zero-run task. It does not change policy, model, backend, task ownership, scope, inputs, artifact paths, archive task, or scientific authority.
authorization.v5_disposition: The prior v5 Anthropic-routing proposal remains retained and unmaterialized. It is not an authorization, is not applied to the task, and is superseded for routing purposes by this exact OpenAI resolution.

    any curve or the historical selection mechanism. High effort is a bounded
    same-policy repair calibration under Core Rule 11.
